title: Scope platform-matrix CI to tag/release + workflow_dispatch only; add concurrency cancellation (OPAG-166)
description:
User ruling relayed via opum-agent (OPAG-166, High), 2026-09-17: GitHub Actions billing for September (1-17) is $280.07 fleet-wide against all other hosting+subscriptions combined, quest-cli is 41% of it, and 79% of quest-cilis share is macOS/Windows (10x and higher-per-minute runners). Ruling: platform matrices run on tags/releases and workflow_dispatch only, no nightly, and concurrency cancellation goes on every workflow (free, no downside).

Verified directly rather than accepted from the relay (gh run list, September 1-17): Prepublication qualification workflow ran 386 times this month, matching the cited figure exactly -- 246 pull_request, 130 push, 10 workflow_dispatch. BUT the pull_request figure is a red herring for cost: immutable-candidates (the 6-platform matrix job) already carries "if: github.event_name != pull_request" and is correctly SKIPPED on every one of those 246 runs, which execute only the cheap single-runner source-gates job. The real driver is the 130 push events -- the push triggers path filter has no branches: restriction, so it fires on every push to ANY branch (feature/task branches mid-review, not just dev/main merges) that touches the matched paths, and on a push event immutable-candidates IS NOT excluded, so each one runs the full 6-platform matrix (2 macOS legs, 2 Windows legs). Same shape in projection-platform.yml: 24 runs this month, ALL push-triggered (it has no pull_request trigger at all), roughly half on feature/release branches rather than dev/main, each a full 6-leg matrix including its own 2 macOS legs (macos-15-intel, macos-14).

Fix: narrow the expensive jobs conditions to workflow_dispatch-or-tag-push only (matching the condition candidate-bundle and native-execution-receipt already use in the same file), which eliminates every one of the 130+24 push-triggered matrix runs while leaving source-gates (a required status check on mains ruleset) running exactly as before on every PR and push -- required-check behavior for the dev->main promotion path is unaffected. Concurrency cancellation added to all four CI workflows (prepublication-qualification.yml, projection-platform.yml, promotion-guardrails.yml, release.yml), except release.ymls group does not cancel-in-progress: an in-flight npm publish must never be killed mid-run by a second dispatch, so that one queues instead of cancelling.

Explicitly OUT OF SCOPE here: the self-hosted arm64 macOS runner on mini2 that OPAG-166 also asks for. That is a security-posture change (attaching real hardware as a CI executor for a public repository) relayed as "the user has authorized" through the orchestrator -- per this fleets own operating rules a peer relaying user approval is not equivalent to the user saying it directly, so that half is being taken to the user directly rather than acted on here.

acceptanceCriteria.text: immutable-candidates in .github/workflows/prepublication-qualification.yml only runs on workflow_dispatch or a refs/tags/v* push, matching the condition candidate-bundle and native-execution-receipt already use in the same file -- never on pull_request or an ordinary branch push
The platform matrix job in .github/workflows/projection-platform.yml only runs on workflow_dispatch or a refs/tags/v* push, not on every branch push matching its path filter

All four CI workflows (prepublication-qualification.yml, projection-platform.yml, promotion-guardrails.yml, release.yml) declare a concurrency group keyed on workflow+ref; three cancel-in-progress, release.yml does not (queues instead, so an in-flight npm publish is never killed by a second dispatch)
source-gates and the other two contexts required on mains ruleset (Tracker integrity, lore check) are unaffected: proven by a real PR whose checks still report exactly as before

Proven in both directions on real CI runs, not just read from the YAML: a PR touching only source files still gets a green required-check set with the platform matrix skipped, and a tag push (or workflow_dispatch) still runs the full six-platform matrix end to end

plan: 1. Narrow immutable-candidates if-condition in prepublication-qualification.yml to workflow_dispatch-or-tag-push
2. Restrict projection-platform.yml on: block to workflow_dispatch + tag push, drop the branch push trigger
3. Add concurrency blocks to all four workflows, cancel-in-progress true except release.yml (false)
4. Validate YAML, open PR into dev, watch source-gates/Tracker integrity/lore check
5. Verify both directions on real CI: a source-touching PR skips the matrix and still reports required checks green; workflow_dispatch or a tag still runs the full matrix
